docs.title: Return policy
docs.body: Unworn items may be returned within 30 days of delivery for a full refund. Final-sale items are not returnable. Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5-7 business days.

docs.title: Shipping options
docs.body: Standard shipping takes 5-8 business days and is free on orders over $75. Express shipping takes 2 business days and costs $18.

docs.title: Warranty
docs.body: Tents and backpacks carry a 2-year limited warranty covering manufacturing defects. Damage from misuse is not covered.

docs.title: Loyalty program
docs.body: Members earn 1 point per dollar spent. 500 points convert to a $10 reward.

docs.title: Customer support hours
docs.body: Customer support is available 8am-6pm Eastern, Monday to Friday, at support@acme-outdoor.example.

docs.title: Size exchanges
docs.body: Size exchanges are free within 60 days.
